label: VERIFIED
extraction: Orchestrator Pipeline two gates and operation family details. Two gates: Gate 1 after Plan - present task_list, do not write implementation code until user approves; Gate 2 before Commit - present diff summary and proposed messages, do not commit until user confirms. Everything between gates flows without stopping. Operation family: orch-add-feature (feature, capability does not exist, first move: research + plan new slice), orch-change-feature (tweak, works but desired behavior differs, first move: amend existing behavior and its tests), orch-fix-defect (fix, broken/wrong behavior, first move: reproduce as failing test then fix), orch-refine-code (refactor, behavior stays structure improves, first move: restructure keeping tests green), orch-build-mvp (mvp, bootstrap from design/spec doc, first move: ingest doc -> vertical slices). Ceremony scales to blast radius via size classification. Phases delegate to existing ECC agents/commands rather than replacing them. Security-reviewer pulled in when diff touches: authentication/authorization, user-input handling, database queries, file-system paths, external API calls, cryptography, secrets/credentials. Handoff artifacts: task_list from Plan drives Implement loop; larger work emits PRD/architecture/system_design under docs/; review findings CRITICAL/HIGH must be resolved before Gate 2.
